en: A colorized vintage postcard depicting a street scene in a European city. The image shows several multi-story buildings with red roofs and green window shutters, typical of late 19th or early 20th-century German architecture. There are people walking on the wide street, some shop signs visible, and a tree on the right side. The sky is illustrated with a gradient from blue to yellow, indicating either dawn or dusk. The words 'Bautzen.' and 'Kaiserstraße.' are printed at the top.
